experiences.title: Data Analysis & Resolution Team (DART) Analyst
experiences.description: Analyzed material and capacity constraints using ERP data and SQL, identifying bottlenecks that cut order cycle time by 18% and prevented 200+ order delays monthly across the distribution network. Created executive dashboards and performance reports tracking key supply chain KPIs (fill rate, lead time, stockout frequency), enabling data-driven decisions that improved capacity utilization by 15%.

experiences.title: Operations Analyst
experiences.description: Managed end-to-end production operations across 3 fabrication lines, from raw aluminum intake through cutting, assembly, and final glazing, maintaining 97% on-time delivery for commercial building projects. Tracked daily output using production dashboards, identified bottlenecks in extrusion and anodizing stages, and collaborated with floor supervisors to cut defect rates by 25%. Coordinated with suppliers on material specifications and delivery schedules; implemented early quality detection protocols that lowered rework costs by $15K/year and reduced scrap waste by 8%. Owned all production documentation (batch records, inspection logs, material certifications), maintaining 100% audit compliance during client and safety audits.
